design_options.summary: Create a serum-bottle-specific owner runtime module with exact prompt and output constants.
design_options.benefit: Smallest behavioral surface and easiest rollback because the apple runtime remains untouched.
design_options.risk: Duplicates owner runtime logic and can drift from the canonical real-bound module.
must_hold: no env file value read by Agent Image Lab
all provider access remains inside VCPToolBox child runtime

design_options.summary: Add an exact binding factory that accepts prompt package and output directory only from a validated packet object.
design_options.benefit: Avoids cloning runtime logic and supports future exact packets with one strict binding path.
design_options.risk: If implemented loosely, it could become a broad arbitrary prompt/output executor.
must_hold: packet can_execute_now must be false until a separate activation package selects it
target_prompt_package_ref must be repository-relative and under prompts/image_generation/
output_directory_ref must be repository-relative and under runs/real_generation/runtime_to_review_v1_guarded_live_probe_serum_bottle/
binding must reject traversal, absolute paths, unknown prompt refs, and output dirs outside the exact packet
binding must not accept raw prompt text from CLI arguments
default no-argument behavior must stay failed-closed

recommended_design.reason: It preserves one runtime logic path while still forcing every future product probe through a validated exact packet. The implementation must be narrow and default-closed.

stop_conditions: implementation would modify current apple owner runtime instead of adding exact packet-bound path
implementation accepts arbitrary prompt refs or raw prompt text
secret value read or env file content read is required by Agent Image Lab
provider contact, plugin call, API call, or image generation is requested during design preflight
retry, max_images greater than 1, or uncapped cost appears
memory, accepted_samples, production candidate, tag, release, deploy, push, force push, or history rewrite is required
next_safe_task: Implement the per-packet exact binding factory only if selected as a local code task; keep default behavior failed-closed and validate without provider contact.
